notes.title: Update 1.8 is live!
notes.notes:
We just released Update 1.8, introducing the "Supervolcanic Eruption" quick game and fixing a bug in the Asteroid Disaster!

Read the full changelog below:

Changes:
[list]
[*] Added the Supervolcanic Eruption quick game to the game!
[*] Reworked Hard Mode:
[list]
[*] Earth will no longer see the effects of their decisions in Hard Mode, bringing them in line with other players.
[*] Players will no longer see when someone targeted them with an ability and what the effects were in Hard Mode.[/list][*] The cursor will now automatically disappear when it is idle for 3 seconds.
[*]Added Chinese voiceovers for News Item headlines in the Supervolcanic Eruption disaster.
[*] Added a config file that allows players to customize lots of game aspects. This file is called “config.default.ini” and can be found in “…/Project Planet - Earth vs Humanity/ProjectPlanet_Data”. Simply copy the default config, name it “config.ini” and make your required changes.
[i]Warning: Using certain values in this config file may break the game. Never delete the “config.default.ini” and delete your custom config in case of game errors.[/i]
[/list]
Balance changes:
[list]
[*] Large range of small buffs and nerfs to bring the balance back in line with the version 1.6 balance, to offset changes caused by the internal systems overhaul in version 1.7.
[*] Added two new questions to the Scientists to improve the balance in Stage 3 of the Solar Flare.
[/list]
Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause the first Sensationalistic video of the Asteroid Impact to not be played.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game could become stuck if a video could not be loaded (as in the previous issue).
[*] Added a new question to the Public to prevent the game from getting stuck on Stage 3 of the Supervolcanic Eruption.
[*] Fixed an issue where Scientists would get +6 score for selling research even if it fails in Supervolcanic Eruption Stage 1.
[*] Fixed an issue where Scientists “Funding received” would show 0 when they got 4 funding.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Public could not choose their third option for one of the questions in the Supervolcanic Eruption Stage 2.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.7 is live!
notes.notes:
We just released Update 1.7, introducing the all new "Supervolcanic Eruption" disaster!

Read the full changelog below:

Changes:
[list]
[*] Added the Supervolcanic Eruption disaster to the game!
[*] The first supervolcanic eruption in modern human history. Originating at the Kikai Caldera in Japan, resulting in massive destruction and tsunamis hitting coastlines around Asia. The ash released will trigger a mini-ice age, resulting in power shortages and famine on a global scale.
[*] Improved the naming of Research Tracks.

[list]
[*] Small change to Earth’s “Nature Pile-Up” decision in the Pest Control stage of the Locust Plague, to make the two cheaper options more appealing.
[*] Small change to Industry’s “After-Effects Discovered” and “After-Effects Need Research” options, to make “Wait and see” option more appealing.
[*] Large overhaul of internal systems that may slightly affect the balance. These changes will be offset in future (balance) updates.
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Renamed server regions to accurately reflect both Hong Kong and Japan as viable options for Chinese players. Choosing the location closest to your location should reduce connection issues. 
[*] Fixed a visual error where Scientists’ funding received indicator displayed received funding for a self-funded research track.
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Blog #26 - Supervolcano Update!
notes.notes:
Welcome back to our Dev Blog!

We're excited to share our progress on our next major content addition: the Supervolcanic Eruption disaster!
[h1]A Cataclysmic Event[/h1]
Our upcoming update introduces the first supervolcanic eruption in modern human history. Coinciding with our Japanese translations, the event centers on the Kikai Caldera in Japan. Players will face:

[list]
[*] Tsunamis affecting coastlines across Asia
[*] Widespread respiratory issues caused by ash
[*] A mini ice age altering global climate
[*] Worldwide power shortages and food scarcity[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341328/c3c9eae03c30af7ae49479e86d6d1c403cbe29f3.png[/img]

We've based this disaster on historical events like the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Youngest_Toba_eruption]Toba supereruption[/url] 74,000 years ago and the 1815 [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1815_eruption_of_Mount_Tambora]Mount Tambora eruption[/url], which resulted in the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Year_Without_a_Summer]Year Without a Summer[/url]. Our goal is to combine humanity’s known struggles when suffering large volcanic eruptions in the past, with the added complexities introduced by modern technology.
[h1]First Look[/h1]
We're thrilled to give you a sneak peek at the Volcano disaster's visuals:

[previewyoutube=Vzwd468YjW4;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Special Announcement[/h1]
We're also excited to reveal that our long-time streaming partner and friend, UserFriendsly, will be showcasing his hidden talent as a voice actor in our new Positive News videos! Let us know if you’re excited to hear him inside the game too!

Recently, he even got to lay his hands on the new disaster in an exclusive sneak peak, so go check out his stream if you're interested!

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2275756476?t=02h46m20s][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341328/e0fe10f7a88875aad25e2ad541dbb7e92a3a4dda.png[/img][/url]

Click the image above for the Supervolcanic Eruption sneak peak stream!

——————————

That’s it for today. Join [url=https://discord.com/invite/CJevhYUhWT]our Discord community[/url] to watch streams, get the latest updates, participate in playtests, and connect with other players. We're always here to answer your questions!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2224610/Project_Planet__Earth_vs_Humanity/

notes.title: Update 1.6 is live!
notes.notes:
We just released Update 1.6, introducing an all new "Hard Mode", Hurricane quick game, lot's of new languages and a dedicated Chinese website.

Read the full changelog below:

Changes:
[list]
[*] Added a new “Hard Mode”!
In this all new game mode, you don’t see the effects your decisions will have before making a decision. This adds a whole new layer of complexity for experienced players, where you need to carefully consider the consequences each decision might have on both the scores and future scenarios.
[*] The Hurricane disaster is now playable in Quick Game mode!
[*] Added a new dedicated website (projectplanet.cn) with hosting in China. This should fix the connection issues some Chinese players were experiencing.
[*] We added a whole list of new (experimental) translations to the game!
[list]

[*] (LATAM) Spanish
[*] (Brazilian) Portuguese

[*] Increased the font size of certain texts on Steam Deck, to improve readability.

[*] Singleplayer games as Earth vs 5 AIs will now be more challenging in the Locust Plague, Influenza Virus, Hurricane and Asteroid Impact disasters, as well as the Quick Game version of the Asteroid Impact.

notes.title: Dev Blog #23 - Update 1.4 & new demo!
notes.notes:
Welcome back for another Dev Blog!

We are incredibly happy with the reception of Update 1.3 and the subsequent hotfix build, as well as the tremendous support we’ve received from our new player base in Asia! But we’ve been hard at work in the meanwhile, so let’s talk about the upcoming Update 1.4!

[h1]Connection Issues[/h1]
Before we talk about Update 1.4, we want to stress that we are aware of connection issues affecting the gameplay for Chinese players. We are currently working on a solution that we believe will solve this issue, but in the meanwhile players are recommended to use the free game accelerator we talked about earlier [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2224610/view/4192362393707209234](more info here)[/url] to mitigate the issue.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43341328/3b5d16c22615a1098ab83ac7e7b1d64ebd5f7bd9.png[/img]

[h1]Update 1.4[/h1]
The next big update brings a mix of fresh content, highly requested features and quality of life improvements, along with bug fixes.

First up, we're expanding the game’s content by introducing the Locust Plague quick game mode alongside the Virus and Solar Flare modes introduced in the last update.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43341328/3cbeee3272853c333f2ed9678301391b8dc67fcf.png[/img]

To ensure clarity and prevent any confusion, AI players now come with their own unique names and an unmistakable AI icon. No more shenanigans with players trying to confuse others by naming themselves “A.I.” (very clever though :P). Alongside this, we've given the cursor a makeover, adopting a Project Planet-inspired design that dynamically highlights clickable elements, making navigation a breeze.

Lastly, in response to requests from Twitch streamers, we've added an option to hide the lobby code on startup and for our Chinese players, we're enhancing their experience with a Chinese version of the tutorial video and Chinese voiceovers for the News Item.

[h1]Balance Improvements[/h1]
Moreover, Update 1.4 brings with it the most comprehensive set of balance improvements to date! With the influx of Chinese players, we've gathered a substantial amount of data on game balance. This update represents a significant step forward in refining and fine-tuning the balance, making the gaming experience even better for all players!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43341328/0f590170711c77bb016df4fe6c7a273dc30bece0.png[/img]

[h1]New Demo[/h1]
Lastly, we're excited to reveal that alongside Update 1.4, we'll be launching a brand new demo version of Project Planet! During development, keeping the demo up to date became quite a task, and we felt it didn't truly capture the game's quality. However, with the improvements in Update 1.4, we're confident that the game is now at a stage where we can maintain the demo effectively and re-release it for everyone to enjoy!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43341328/e8f70b9b876b267bf4fc66acebd068c93f45f3c4.png[/img]

——————————

That’s it for today. Keep an eye out for the many streams by [url=https://discord.com/invite/CJevhYUhWT]joining our Discord community[/url]. Here you can also stay up to date on the latest updates, find others to play with, join our playtests or get in touch and ask us questions!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2224610/Project_Planet__Earth_vs_Humanity/

notes.title: Update 1.3 is live!
notes.notes:
We just released Update 1.3, with lots of cool new features and the Chinese language added!

This introduces much requested Steam Achievements, an all-new Quick Game mode where you can play shorter disasters with only two stages, hot joining and lots more.

Read the full changelog below:

Changes:
[list]
[*] Added Steam Achievements! A much requested feature, Project Planet now has over 70 achievements to show off your planet-destroying (or saving) skills to your friends!
[*] Added Chinese translations to the game! Languages can be selected in your Steam library under Project Planet -> Properties -> General -> Language.
[*] Added local servers for Asian players. Servers can be selected in the top right corner of the lobby screen. Note that players must have the same server region selected when logging in on www.projectplanet.tv.

[*] Font change. Many texts should now be more readable.

[/list]

[list]
[*] Nullifying all stage results as Planet Earth (-25% all results) now generates 6 Force, up from 4.
[*] Amplifying all stage results as Planet Earth (+25% all results) now costs 3 Force, down from 4.
[*] Nerfed Scientists in the Locust Plague disaster.
[*] Nerfed Industry in the Influenza Virus disaster.
[*] Slightly nerfed Media and the Public in the Hurricane disaster, while slightly buffing Scientists.
[*] Slightly nerfed Scientists in the Asteroid Impact disaster.
[*] Nerfed the Public in the Solar Flare disaster, while slightly buffing Earth.

notes.title: Dev Blog #21 - Update 1.3
notes.notes:
Welcome back for another Dev Blog!

Project Planet is now 30% off during Steam’s Remote Play Together festival, but we’re also excited to share some more info on the upcoming Update 1.3!

notes.title: Update 1.2 is live!
notes.notes:
We just released Update 1.2, our largest update so far!

This introduces the all-new Solar Flare disaster, as well as new turn and read time customization, notifications when someone used an ability on you, and lots of balance changes and bug fixing!

[previewyoutube=YQi2l0CaJHU;full][/previewyoutube]

Changes:
[list]
[*] Added the Solar Flare disaster to the game!
You can now play a large solar flare and coronal mass ejection, causing the destruction of satellites, energy grids and other ground technology. Humanity will be left without power, communication and eventually even food and water for months or even years.
[*] Added turn timers to the game.
You can now select how long players have to answer a question, ranging from 10 seconds to 3 minutes, or completely disabled. When the timer reaches 0, a random answer will be selected for the player. This should help keep the game moving along in case someone is AFK or not paying attention.
[*] Added Read Times to the game.
You can now customize the duration of notifications and news items to align with your reading speed. Opt for "Very Fast" settings to swiftly dismiss messages for an accelerated gaming experience.
[*] You will now receive a notification when you are targeted by another player’s ability. Tap the notification for more information, or dismiss it by pressing the X-button.
[*] Introduced a new option for Earth’s final decision in some stages, with a random (positive or negative) effect on Population at 0 Force cost.
[*] Reduced the length of the Virus disaster’s first stage by ~3 questions on average. This brings the disaster more in line with the other disasters’ lengths.
[*] Ability options now have titles. The tooltip explaining the effect (cooperative/hostile, self-interest or environmental) that was previously shown in the title is moved to just below the answer title.
[*] Added an overview of active and past Stages in the question screen on web.
[*] Made a wide range of improvements to existing texts.
[*] Changed the unlockable <33% Ecosystems and Pollution Incidents to -6 Population and -2 Ecosystems or Pollution, from -2 Population and -6 Ecosystems or Pollution. This change should create a bigger payoff for reaching the lowest threshold of Ecosystems and Pollution, as players tend to reach these levels towards the end of the game when the impact of Ecosystems and Pollution is lower.
[/list]
Balance changes:
[list]
[*] Decreased the impact of minus Population decisions by 3% to offset the previous change.
[*] Nerfed Earth and the Media’s impact on Population in Stage 3 and 4 of the Asteroid Impact, while increasing their impact on Ecosystems & Pollution. This should make it easier for Humanity to survive this disaster.
[*] Slightly nerfed Earth in the Hurricane disaster.
[*] Slightly nerfed World Leaders in the Asteroid Impact disaster, but buffed World Leaders in the Hurricane and Locust Plague disasters.
[*] Slightly nerfed Scientists in the Locust Plague disaster, but buffed Scientists in the Asteroid Impact disaster.
[*] Nerfed the Industry in the Virus disaster.
[*] Buffed the Public's endgame in the Virus and Asteroid Impact disasters.
[/list]
Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where an A.I. Earth could use more difficult Crises than human players.
[*] Fixed an issue where certain news items in Locust Plague stage 1 had incorrect titles and voiceovers.
[*] Fixed an issue where two decisions had no cost for a Scientists track in Asteroid Stage 1.
[*] Fixed two small issues with Earth Incident values.
[*] Fixed a blurry font in the settings menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1 is live!
notes.notes:
We just released Update 1.1!

This introduces the much-anticipated Asteroid Impact disaster, as well as a rework for the Crisis system, balance changes and a lot of other fixes and improvements.

[previewyoutube=Dt2pScB_5MU;full][/previewyoutube]
Changes:
[list]
[*] Added the Asteroid Impact disaster!
[*] Players can now play a severe asteroid impact disaster, with scenarios ranging from investigating the point of impact, evacuating residents, rescuing survivors and dealing with the environmental after effects of this devastating cataclysm!
[*] Crisis rework:
[*] We’ve noticed that many experienced Earth players would never use the Crisis, as the risk of losing Force without decreasing the Population (if Humanity successfully prevents the Crisis) is too big. To combat this, we’ve reworked the Crisis to be a lot cheaper to use, and have a viable 0 Force option in case Earth doesn’t want to risk any Force.

The Crisis now has four different options:
[list]
[*] 0 Force cost, 18 points required by humanity, -2 Population if successful.
[*] 1 Force cost, 23 points required by humanity, -4 Population if successful.
[*] 2 Force cost, 28 points required by humanity, -6 Population if successful.
[*] 3 Force cost, 33 points required by humanity, -8 Population if successful.
[/list][*] The Teamplayer and Egotistical awards in the Stage results screen are now based on most positive and negative impact on Population, Ecosystem & Pollution. Before, Egotistical used to be based on the most positive effect on a player's own score, which often resulted in the player that used the most abilities getting the Egotistical award.
[*] AI controlled humanity players will now use abilities.
[*] Added a borderless windowed mode
[/list]
Balance changes:
[list]
[*] Nerfed the Industry role in the Hurricane and Virus disasters.
[*] Nerfed the Public role in the Hurricane disaster.
[*] Slightly buffed the Scientists role in the Hurricane disaster.
[*] Buffed Earth's options in Hurricane Stage 4.
[/list]
Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause the game to end early in Hurricane Stage 3.
[*] Fixed an issue where AI would not take over a kicked player when that player had one or more questions queued, for example while answering an ability while another question is queued.
[*] Normalized the audio levels for all news videos, fixing an issue where some had low audio levels.
[/list]

notes.notes:
We just released update 1.0.2!

[*] Added a new reconnect system to the master device. This should prevent games from getting locked out of the game when the master device loses connection for a short period of time.

[*] Ability Environmental options now affect your target by 4 instead of 3. This should make them slightly more impactful and appealing.
[*] Slightly buffed the Media role in the Locust Plague disaster and added an extra question at the end of Stage 4.
[*] Slightly nerfed the Public role in the Locust Plague disaster.
[*] Slightly nerfed the Industry role in the Virus and Hurricane disasters.
[/list]
Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where AI Earth would always select the Virus. Additionally, AI Earth will now choose different disasters when playing multiple games in a single game session.
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause the game to end early in Virus Stage 4.
[*] Fixed an issue where “investigation of decision makers” in Hurricane Stage 4 would negatively affect the Media instead.
[*] Fixed multiple issues with News Item voiceover volume levels.
[*] Fixed multiple spelling mistakes.
[*] Removed unnecessary “Funding received:” texts in certain research tracks.
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Blog #16 - First week of release!
notes.notes:
Welcome back for another Dev Blog, the first one since Monday’s game launch!

Today we’re covering the amazing time we had in the first days of the release, changes coming in the first updates, and we’re revealing the final winners of the community meme contest.
[h1]Release[/h1]
Monday was a dream come true for us. With lots of people tuning in to Twitch to see the official release ([url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1934741606]VOD here[/url]) and going from Popular Upcoming Releases to New & Trending on Steam within a few hours, it far exceeded our expectations for our tiny indie game. Thanks so much for all your support!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43341328/4e442c21257ec5fa912d572400c7de9722e3e8ad.png[/img]
[h1]Next Updates[/h1]
While we’re trying our hardest to enjoy the moment with the great reception and all the new players finding out about Project Planet, it’s also time to look to the future. We already have two updates in development, one being a smaller update with mostly bug fixes and improvements, and one being a larger content update that will introduce the much anticipated Asteroid Impact disaster to the game!

The smaller update will be patch 1.0.2 and is expected to be released within the next week. Some of the changes included in this build are:
[list]
[*] A new reconnect system for the master device, to prevent players from getting locked out of their game if the master device loses connection for a short amount of time.
[*] A variety of balance changes.
[*] Fix for a bug that would cause an AI Earth to always select the Virus disaster.
[*] Multiple fixes to small bugs and game stoppers.[/list]

[list]

[*] Mod support for players to create their own scenarios

notes.title: Update 0.12 is live!
notes.notes:
We just released update 0.12! This introduces lots of new and improved gameplay features, like a complete overhaul and clearer communication of how Ecosystems and Pollution allow Earth to unlock new questions and Incidents, as well as some balance tweaks and minor bug fixes.

Full changelog:

Changes:
[list]
[*] Players now receive a turn notification screen in the colour of their role on their mobile device to warn them when it’s their turn.
[*] Reintroduced the options button in the lobby. This time without game breaking bugs.
[*] You can now remove players from the Lobby and select a new party leader on the master device.
[*] Added Game Credits to the main menu
[*] Added two new unlockable Incidents to Planet Earth.
[*] Earth’s unlockable Incidents are now unlocked at 67% and 33% Ecosystems and Pollution, instead of only at 50%.
[*] Earth’s Incidents that are only available when Ecosystems or Pollution is under 66% or 33% will now be available immediately after meeting this condition, instead of only after Earth used another Incident. (Senzi, you’re welcome)
[*] Unlocked questions and Incidents now show the unlock criteria, and a red outline and fill colour to more clearly differentiate them from regular questions and Incidents.
[*] Updated the Ecosystems and Pollution’s score bars on the master device, to more clearly communicate the unlock criteria for unlockable questions and Incidents.
[*] Replaced the role names with player names in the Stage Results and Game Over screen, to make it clearer which player won (role icon still shows which role won).
[*] Earth’s Influence Scores question at the end of each stage now has a different background image to make it stand out.
[*] The Game Over screen now has separate SFXs and music depending on whether Earth or Humanity won.
[*] Improved the names and wording for Nemesis, Stage Results, Crisis Results and Game Over awards.
[*] Earth now has a unique Nemesis screen, showing which player had the most positive and negative impact on the Population, Ecosystems and Pollution (combined).
[/list]

Balance changes:
[list]
[*] Slightly nerfed Public and Industry in Hurricane disaster, while buffing Media and Earth.
[*] Slightly nerfed Earth in Virus disaster.
[*] Slightly buffed World Leaders and Media in Locust Plague disaster.
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Earth wouldn’t always have three Incident options to choose from. (again welcome, Senzi)
[*] Fixed an issue where the music would stop playing when a News Video would bring the Population below or above a threshold where another song starts playing.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Earth Influence choices in the first tab of the Results Screen would show outdated icons for -8 Population, Ecosystems or Pollution.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Crisis could trigger in the background of a News Video.
[*] Fixed an issue where “Power” was called “Influence” in the Power tutorial popup.
[*] Fixed multiple incorrect News Item voiceovers.
[*] The Crisis timer on the master device and mobile devices are now more in-sync.
[*] Many minor fixes to texts and scores.
[/list]

notes.notes:
Welcome back for another Dev Blog, and an exciting one at that!

Project Planet finally has a planned release date, and you won’t have to wait long!
[h1]Release Date[/h1]
We’re officially announcing that Project Planet will release on [b]Monday the 25th of September[/b]!

It’s been a long three years of hard work, but seeing the community play and enjoy our game over these past few months has been an amazing experience and has given us more energy than ever to make this final push! We cannot wait to welcome even more players to Project Planet when we finally release the full version.

Over the next month and a half, we will work together with a wide range of streamers to give players a sneak peek of the new disasters. Keep an eye out for these streams on our Discord [url=https://www.twitch.tv/projectplanettv](or follow our Twitch channel)[/url], or join our weekly community streams each Friday @8PM CEST for exclusive access!

The game will launch with a total of three disasters (Virus, Locust Plague & Hurricane) with the Asteroid Impact being added in the first update. After that we will add two more disasters, with the Solar Flare and Volcanic Eruption through later updates.

notes.title: Update 0.11 is live!
notes.notes:
We just released update 0.11.1, a minor patch improving the Crisis, fixing some issues and preparing the game for a closed Beta of the full release.

Full changelog:

Changes:
[list]
[*] Made multiple tweaks to the Crisis: Earth can now only choose from 0, -1, -2, -4 and -6 Force, effect when Crisis is not prevented was increased by -2 Population (Population is now reduced by amount of Force spent plus two), and crisis UI has been improved on mobile for both Earth and Humanity players
[*] Reduced length of certain texts that appeared in the News Banner at the bottom of the screen.
[*] Added new Game Over screen banners for “Humanity won” and “Earth won”.
[*] Removed player reconnect sounds during the game and the tutorial.
[*] Players now maintain their spot in the lobby even when disconnected, unless the player presses "Leave".
[/list]
Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where players would not see their question until they refreshed their browser. Note that this may still occur, but should happen a lot less frequently.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would get stuck when Earth would trigger a Crisis after their final question of a Stage was queued.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.10 is live!
notes.notes:
We just released update 0.10.1, addressing a large list of issues and points of feedback from Steam Next Fest and our Discord community!

This update fixes the issue where abilities wouldn't always work when used, increases turn timers of the AI to make it easier to follow what's going on, and fixes an issue where the game wouldn't always end when the population hit 0, among many other things.

For a full list, check the change log below:

Changes:
[list]
[*] Increased AI decision timers by 3s and another 0.5s for each additional AI in the game (after one). This should make it easier to follow what’s going on for new players, especially when playing singleplayer.
[*] Decreased impact of Population effects by ~5%.
[*] When players bid the same amount in a Crisis where Humanity spent enough resources, the ability will now go to the player with the most Power instead of the player who was fastest to answer.
[*] Reduced Force cost of cheapest Trigger Incidents (-2 Ecosystems/Pollution) for Planet Earth from 2 to 1.
[*] Adjusted certain Trigger Incident values that made these options too unappealing.
[*] Reduced the impact of Earth’s "Heart Failure" option in Virus Stage 4 from -6 to -4 Population, to reduce the extreme Population decline at the end of the stage.
[*] Earth decisions that cost 0 Force will now also show the Force cost behind the titles.
[*] Added disaster-specific background images to the web environment.
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where abilities would not always activate when used on the same target more than once.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Population would count down to 0 and then suddenly jump back to a previous value, not ending the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would not end if the Population hit 0 during the Stage Results Screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where Notifications and the Live Feed would not show up in future games when players returned to lobby at a specific time.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused texture settings to always be set to Low by default.
[*] Fixed an issue where the wrong tag would be displayed on certain abilities.
[*] Fixed an issue where Population decline from Ecosystems & Pollution was swapped in the score screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where two options in the Industry abilities would have the swapped score effects.
[*] Fixed an issue where players that were disconnected when the Crisis started could not spend any points.
[*] Fixed an issue where the icon representing score being spent on the Crisis was blue (points gained) instead of red (points lost).
[*] Fixed a visual issue with the Research Completed banner on mobile.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Industry would not always get a question in Virus stage 1.
[*] Fixed an issue where the wrong news item would show in Virus stage 2.
[*] Fixed an incorrect Live Feed message in Virus stage 3.
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Blog #9 - Demo release date announcement!
notes.notes:
Welcome back for unquestionably the most exciting dev blog so far!

Last month we revealed our plans to release a demo soon, and today we are thrilled to announce that a release date has been set!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43341328/e8f70b9b876b267bf4fc66acebd068c93f45f3c4.png[/img]

[h1]Demo Release - May 31st[/h1]
After almost three years of development, we are proud to announce our demo will go live on Wednesday the 31st of May! We have been living towards this moment for a long while now, and we can’t wait to hear the first feedback from you guys.

Just to recap, the demo will feature one fully playable Disaster—the Influenza Virus—and all six player roles will be fully playable! You’ll also be able to invite your friends to tag along, even if they haven’t downloaded the demo. Just stream the game through a video conference tool like Zoom or Discord, and you’re good to go! Or sit down on your couch and run it on your TV, for the ultimate couch multiplayer experience!

So mark your calendars, get ready to give Project Planet a go and let us know what you think!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43341328/24fd87a5d1ac4a8eccbff259f2de1d32a1c3cccb.png[/img]

That’s it for today. Be sure to [url=https://linktr.ee/projectplanetgame]follow us on our social channels for more content[/url]!

And if you want to get in touch or ask us questions, [url=https://discord.com/invite/CJevhYUhWT]head over to our Discord community![/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2224610/Project_Planet__Earth_vs_Humanity/

notes.title: Dev Blog #8 - Demo release!
notes.notes:
Welcome back for another very exciting dev blog!

Last time we revealed our Gameplay Trailer, but this time we have something even better to share with you!

[h1]Project Planet Demo[/h1]

These last few weeks we’ve been working extremely hard to prepare a playable demo for Project Planet, and we’re happy to announce it will be coming very soon! The exact date is yet to be determined, but you can expect to get your first hands-on experience with Project Planet within the next 2-3 months.

The demo will feature one fully playable Disaster—none other than the Influenza Virus—and all six player roles will be fully playable! You’ll also be able to invite your friends to tag along, even if they haven’t downloaded the demo. Just stream the game through a video conference tool like Zoom or Discord, and you’re good to go!

We can’t wait to hear what you think about the game and will eagerly be awaiting all your feedback and suggestions!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43341328/427ba65aa35f564a53d5493e5a9f8e6e61097513.png[/img]

That’s it for today. Be sure to [url=https://linktr.ee/projectplanetgame]follow us on our social channels for more content[/url]!
